title: A skip link or landmarks let you go past the navigation bar
note: no skip link (first Tab goes to Home nav link), but VoiceOver rotor lists a main landmark

title: All navigation bar items work with the keyboard
note: all 4 nav items open with Enter

title: Search and all filters work with the keyboard
note: search and all 5 filters (Department, Level, Credits, Availability, Sort) work with the keyboard

title: You can fill in and submit the registration form with the keyboard
note: all fields can be filled and the form submits; policy checkbox: Tab from Notes, VoiceOver reads 'checkbox, unchecked' and Space checks it (first try without VoiceOver looked like Space did nothing, likely because the focus is not visible, see K8)

title: Course card buttons and table buttons (register / drop) work with the keyboard
note: catalog card Register and profile table Drop both work with Enter

title: The focus does not get stuck anywhere on the page
The focus order follows the visual order
The focus is always visible
note: register: no visible focus on the course checkboxes or the policy checkbox (VoiceOver off); CSS input:focus sets outline:none

title: The focused element is not hidden behind other content
The focus goes into the modal when it opens
note: Enter right after the modal opens runs its main button

title: Tab and Shift+Tab stay in the modal while it is open
note: Tab and Shift+Tab stay in the modal

title: Esc and the close or cancel button close the modal
note: Esc, Cancel and the close button all close the modal

title: The focus goes back to the button that opened the modal
note: after Esc, Enter reopens the modal, so focus went back to the submit button (tested with keyboard submit; mouse submit leaves focus elsewhere in Safari)

title: VoiceOver says that a dialog opened and reads its name
note: modal has role=dialog, aria-modal=true, aria-labelledby to its h2 'Confirm your registration'

title: Each field has a visible label and VoiceOver reads it
note: register: every field has a visible <label for>; course checkboxes and policy checkbox are wrapped in labels

title: Required fields are marked with text or a symbol that is explained (not color only)
note: registration: required fields have a red * but no text on the page explains what * means (borderline, raise at calibration)

title: An empty or wrong submit shows each error in text next to its field
note: empty submit: error text shows next to each field

title: Each error message tells how to correct it
note: Student ID: "Enter a valid student ID (e.g. S2026-0417)." gives an example; Email: "Enter a valid email address." has no example (borderline, raise at calibration)

title: VoiceOver reads the errors after submit
note: register: after an empty submit, VoiceOver reads the errors (tested); note the code only moves the scroll, not the focus, and announces the toast 'Please fix the highlighted fields.'

title: VoiceOver reads the result count after a search or filter change and the focus stays in place
note: catalog: #result-count is aria-live=polite, text 'Showing N of 16 courses'; focus stays in search

title: VoiceOver reads the confirmation after you register or drop a course
note: register: success opens a second dialog 'Registration complete!'; drop shows toast '<code> has been dropped.' in a role=status live region

title: Each page or view has a title that tells what it is
note: each page has its own title: UniReg · Home / Course Catalog / Registration / My Profile

title: Headings: one h1 per view and levels in a logical order
note: home: h1 'Build your perfect semester', h2 section titles, h3 card and step titles; no level jumps in the markup

title: Landmarks: banner or header and navigation and main and footer
note: home rotor: banner, navigation, main, content information

title: Link and button names tell what they do
note: home: course card links in the rotor are all named just "Register", with no course name

title: Meaningful images and icons have a text alternative and decorative ones are hidden
note: no img elements; nav and card emoji have aria-hidden=true; seats bar is a labelled progressbar

title: VoiceOver reads the column header for each cell of the registered-courses table
note: profile: table has <thead> with <th> for each column (Code, Course, Department, ...), sortable headers set aria-sort

title: Dropdowns and toggles and tabs announce their role and state (for example expanded or selected)
note: only custom control is the mobile menu button (visible under 860px), it has aria-expanded and aria-controls; filters are native selects

title: The navigation bar tells which page is the current page
note: nav link of current page has aria-current="page"

title: At 320 px width there is no horizontal scroll and no content is lost
note: all 4 pages fit at 320 x 568, no sideways page scroll (incl. profile)

title: At 200% zoom all text is readable and nothing is cut off or on top of other content
note: profile at 200%: layout does not reflow, the content is wider than the header and the page needs sideways scroll, but no text is cut off, overlapping or missing once you scroll (borderline, raise at calibration)

title: Errors and status and selected filters are not shown by color only
note: form errors and filter states always have text, not color only

title: Focus indicators and field borders have a contrast of at least 3:1
note: lowest 1.1:1. Measured with CCA: empty field border on white 1.1:1 (fail); orange nav focus ring on header 1.8:1 (fail); purple focused field border on white 4.9:1 (pass)

title: The needs-review contrast sample passes (4.5:1 for normal text and 3:1 for large text)
note: home, measured with CCA, all normal text (needs 4.5:1): nav 'My Profile' white on header 2.5:1; hero subtitle 'Browse courses...' white on #BC4EB3 4.3:1; stat card 'Open courses' white on green 2:1; typed text in hero search box white on white 1:1. All fail
